title: The “credit check” needs your bank login
scenario: A landlord says too many students send fake credit reports, so you must prove affordability through a link that connects directly to your bank account using your online-banking credentials.

answers.A: Use a recognized tenant-screening method or provide appropriate documents through a verified landlord/platform; do not enter banking credentials into an unknown link.
answers.B: Ask the landlord to use a reputable screening service and verify the property before sharing financial data.
answers.C: Connect the bank because read-only financial verification is common and faster than sending statements.

explanation: Bank-connect services can be legitimate, but only when the property, landlord and provider are independently verified. An unknown link is not enough.
proTip: Verify the rental before verifying your finances.
